flow.description: Librarian capture + distill pipeline — batch/idle, not per-turn

stages.note: Tool use already captured; prompt+response is NEW addition

stages.trigger: idle_timer(30s) OR buffer_size(>=5 turns) OR session_end
stages.note: Never per-turn — batch only to save token cost on distill LLM call

stages.gate: Only verified points proceed to clean RAG

stages.policy: RAW NEVER PROMOTED DIRECTLY TO RAG

raw_schema.description: Raw capture in JSONL staging — immutable append-only

distilled_point_schema.description: One distilled_point per semantic unit — subject/subtopic/point triple

fields.subject: string (broad domain, e.g. RAG pipeline, auth)
fields.subtopic: string (narrower, e.g. chunking strategy, token refresh)
fields.evidence_snippet: string|null (key quote from raw, for OpeC audit)
fields.session_ids: string[] (sessions this point was observed in)
fields.observation_count: int (how many turns reinforce this point)

distilled_point_schema.dedup_rule: If same (subject, subtopic, semantic_equivalent(point)) exists, increment observation_count + merge session_ids instead of creating new

DISTILLED.description: Distilled points created, awaiting OpeC verification

PARTIALLY_VERIFIED.action: Resolve suspect/reject before clean RAG ingest

VERIFIED.description: All distilled points for this batch verified

RAG_INDEXED.description: Points ingested into clean RAG index

ERROR.action: Retry with backoff or manual intervention

writer_policy.capture_mode: automatic — every turn end appends to raw_staging
writer_policy.excluded_reason: Query-only clients; their context is volatile/search, not canonical knowledge
writer_policy.note: Extended from tool-use-only to full turn capture (prompt + response)

distill_policy.anti_per_turn: Never distill a single turn — wait for batch threshold
distill_policy.model: fast/cheap LLM (distill is extractive summarization, not generation)
distill_policy.prompt_template: Extract atomic facts/decisions from these {N} conversation turns. Output JSON array of {subject, subtopic, point, confidence, evidence_snippet}. Deduplicate semantically identical points.

rag_policy.never_promote: RAW transcripts — no bypass, no exception
rag_policy.index_format: Vector embed subject+subtopic+point; metadata = {id, tags, writer, observation_count, last_seen}
rag_policy.staleness: Points with observation_count>=5 AND last_seen > 90d → OpeC review for decay
rag_policy.query_access: READ-ONLY — cannot write raw or distilled, can only READ clean RAG index

unit: Raw capture appends correctly for Claude/Codex turns
Raw capture REJECTS writes from Hermes/CommandCode/OpenCode/Cline
Idle timer fires distill after 30s of no turns
Dedup: same point increments observation_count, does not duplicate
Confidence threshold: points below 0.5 auto-flagged suspect
integration: Full pipeline: capture → idle → batch distill → OpeC verify → RAG ingest
OpeC reject cascades: rejected point never reaches RAG
RAG query from Hermes returns only verified points
Raw pruning only after OpeC confirms all entries verified
edge_cases: Empty turn (no prompt/response) — skip capture with warning
Very long prompt (>100K chars) — truncate with marker, flag for review
Distill model timeout — retry 3x then escalate to OpeC
Concurrent writes from two Claude sessions — JSONL append is safe (append-only)
RAG index corruption — rebuild from verified distilled_points (idempotent)

F1_capture_loss.cause: Writer crash mid-write, disk full, permission error
F1_capture_loss.mitigation: JSONL append is atomic per line; detect gap in turn_index sequence
F1_capture_loss.recovery: Replay missing turn from session log (if available) or mark gap

F2_distill_hallucination.symptom: Distilled point not supported by raw evidence
F2_distill_hallucination.mitigation: OpeC verification step with evidence_snippet cross-check
F2_distill_hallucination.recovery: Reject point; optionally re-distill with lower temperature

F3_rag_pollution.symptom: Raw or unverified points in clean RAG
F3_rag_pollution.mitigation: Hard gate: rag_indexed flag ONLY set after verification.status='ok'
F3_rag_pollution.recovery: Purge RAG index, rebuild from verified distilled_points

F4_stale_points.symptom: Outdated facts in RAG (e.g. old API, deprecated pattern)
F4_stale_points.mitigation: observation_count + last_seen staleness check; OpeC periodic audit
F4_stale_points.recovery: OpeC marks stale → re-verify or tombstone

F5_writer_spoof.cause: Auth bypass or misconfigured writer policy
F5_writer_spoof.mitigation: Enforce writer allowlist at capture entrypoint (not just policy doc)
F5_writer_spoof.recovery: Audit log; delete unauthorized entries; harden entrypoint
